subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------POL.SIGN.
description: Diagram in EVOL-20. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the progressional continuance of western culture is designed to perpetuate the affinity dynamics of what it perceives to be real to white America... What we are experiencing in this time cycle is no mere case of extended affinity dynamics - but rather, a continuance consciously designed for particular aims.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of interpretation structurally meets political significance at the consciously-designed-continuance scale: (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) crossed with POL-SIGN (political significance). INTR sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) upper-left and INT (intention) upper-right with APL-DT (application dictates) at right. AF-NT (affinity nature), MOT-DY (motion dynamics), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) form the left chain. INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) center; ROTP (responsibility of the position), SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular), OPT-SD (option-side) on the right. POL-SIGN sits at lower-center as partner-axis with UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) adjacent and CULT-O (culture order) at lower-left. Structural argument: when reality-of-interpretation is crossed with political-significance, the upper diagonal VT-DY -> INT -> APL-DT is the conscious-design route - vibrational-dynamics routes through intention into application-dictates on the partner-axis upper-right. The lower chain to POL-SIGN through ROTP/SOC-RT-P/OPT-SD shows what political-significance converts the form's introduction into - responsibility-of-the-positions and social-reality particulars - rather than letting INDIV-TD's individual-tendencies carry the form's introduction directly.
